message:
docs(policy): three-role procedure -- Codex plans, a verifying Claude confirms and inspects, a working Claude implements

AGENTS.md rewrites the role-separation section as the flow the user approved on 2026-09-07:
Codex plan -> verifying Claude review/confirmation -> working Claude implementation ->
verifying Claude inspection and explicit OK -> Codex final confirmation. Codex does not
change files, build, test or commit; the verifier never edits or commits tracked files and
never approves its own work; the worker asks the verifier first and never asks Codex for
final sign-off without the verifier's OK. Roles are identified by the bus tab displayName
and a2a_whoami; ephemeral session ids are not written into policy.

CLAUDE.md adds the two Claude sessions' concrete conduct and reporting standard, including
the fixed form of the verifier's "implementation OK" (commit, scope, what the verifier ran
vs. what the worker reported, artifact name/size/sha256/build commit, unverified limits),
re-inspection after any later change, and the rule that a standalone pass never offsets a
reproduced regression failure. history #408.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
